VAULT_REPO.description: The GitHub repo your Cairn vault syncs to, as `owner/name`.

VAULT_BRANCH.description: Its branch. Cairn syncs to `main` unless you changed it.

GITHUB_TOKEN.description: A [fine-grained token](https://github.com/settings/personal-access-tokens/new) with **Contents: read and write** on the vault repo only.

ACCESS_TEAM_DOMAIN.description: Leave empty for now. After you add Cloudflare Access, set it to your team domain, `<team>.cloudflareaccess.com`. Until then the companion serves no notes.

ACCESS_AUD.description: Leave empty for now. After you add Cloudflare Access, set it to the Access application's **AUD tag**.

ALLOWED_EMAILS.description: Optional: the only emails let in, comma-separated, checked as well as your Access policy.
